# Discovery call: Acme Freight (synthetic, a fictional company)

Attendees by role: client operations lead, client finance lead; our sales lead, our solution architect.

- Staff quote shipments by hand from a printed tariff. It is slow and two staff often quote different prices for
  the same shipment.
- The operations lead wants "faster, better quotes" (no number given).
- Finance says prices must always round up to the next whole number. Operations says rounding to the nearest is
  fine.
- Dangerous goods must never be quoted by a tool; a person at ops handles them.
- The client has looked at an off-the-shelf rate calculator and found it too rigid.
- They want it "live in six weeks" and a pitch decision by the end of next month.
- Quotes are for staff only; it would run on a staff laptop; no customer data is stored.
